# Certified local exit-scope diagnostic

Retain the original exit preparation, each actual check, split summaries, clause
order, fuel traversal, active reveal context and procedure contracts. Place the
complete pure exit proof in the existing PathAsideBlock; do not publish internal
preparation to another exit or the method continuation. Unsupported preparation
fails the diagnostic rather than silently changing it. Require unchanged native
controls, strict actual-check/full-attribute fingerprints, and genuine Invalid
false-entry controls. This is a focused resource investigation, not product
adoption or acceptance. No normal workflow enables it.
